format: MW-LOG/1 ledger state rules (v0.3 freeze group)
about: DAG-level vectors for the freeze-group state rules (docs/review/V03-DESIGN-REVIEW.md 2.5.3, 2.10; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 15.4). Each vector lists real signed blocks (site, genesisOwner) in an arrival order; reduce() of those blocks, in any order, gives expect: kv, lists (values, oldest first), profiles, banned (sorted: every key a ban at the heads reaches, whatever its until, State.policy.banUntil; since the v0.3 code review State.policy.banned holds the permanent bans only), keyinfo (author -> rc), keychange (pub -> { from, next, by }), hidden (sorted hashes of payload blocks whose value is dropped) and checkpoint (the checkpoint block in effect). A checkpoint vector also gives S and the hashes of the blocks after it: reduceFromCheckpoint(S, those blocks) gives the same state. APPEND ONLY: see LOCK.json. Vectors lg-021 to lg-025 (code review v0.3, MF-20 and the moderator cap) use the review.* names.

vectors.description: A moderator lifts a moderator ban for blocks in the unban's causal future; the blocks the ban hid stay hidden.
An owner ban is lifted only by the owner: a moderator unban leaves it in place.
The owner lifts its own ban for blocks after the unban.
A ban with until governs the author's blocks with ts < until only.
The first keyinfo per author in total order counts; a moderator tombstone or ban cannot remove it.
A recover rotation of from overrides a self rotation earlier in total order.
A recover rotation of from overrides a self rotation later in total order.
Among recover rotations of one key the lowest (depth, h) wins.
A recover rotation whose rp does not hash to from's keyinfo.rc has no effect.
next inherits from's allow membership, never moderator standing.
next inherits from's bans.
A voided moderator's control blocks outside the causal past of after have no effect.
A moderator tombstone of payload written with owner standing has no effect.
"@" + 16 characters of b64url(sha256(author)) + "/" keys take effect only from that author.
A bulk tombstone hides every payload of the listed authors not in the causal future of before; a moderator never hides owner-standing payload.
Moderator allow additions beyond modAllowPerDay per UTC day of the claimed ts have no effect.
The day count restarts on the next UTC day; the earlier write stays outside the later allow (causal fold).
Moderator ban, tombstone and unban blocks beyond modActionsPerHour per claimed hour have no effect.
A non-matching mw.* item is valid and stored but hidden; bare names such as dm are not reserved.
An owner checkpoint settles its covered blocks into S; reduce from S plus the later blocks equals reduce of the full DAG, and a later block naming a covered parent is accepted.

A keyinfo counts only as the key's first word here (code review v0.3, MF-20): written after the key's first block it is ignored, so a recover rotation keyed to it has no effect and the new key inherits nothing.
A rotation is a revocation (code review v0.3, MF-20): blocks of from that are not in the causal past of the rotation in effect have no effect; next inherits the allow membership.

blocks.v: the old key after the recovery
the old key beside the recovery

vectors.description: Bans cover the rotation family in both directions (code review v0.3, MF-20): a ban of next also hides what from wrote before the rotation.
Concurrent keyinfo blocks of one key with one rc are one commitment (two devices); two rcs with neither first are none (code review v0.3, MF-20).

The moderator hour cap counts a block in the hour of max(ts, the newest ts in its causal past) (code review v0.3): tombstones that claim earlier hours than the posts they build on share those posts' hour.

Review round (HUB-1, SYB-1): a banned key's self rotation onto a key that never signed it (no nsig) retires the old key only: next inherits neither the ban nor anything else, and is not shown "key changed".
A self rotation next agreed to (nsig) joins the keys: next inherits from's ban (2.5.3), so the victim of lg-026 is banned only when it signed.
Review round (HUB-4, SYB-2): a moderator block takes effect only with the policy that appointed the key in its causal past; a ban forked from before the appointment has none.

Review round (HUB-6): a put without owner standing does not replace or delete a reserved entry written with owner standing (the owner's _deny/ takedown and _mw.cfg stand); a moderator's own _deny/ entry is in effect.
